an8.25:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
an8.25:1.2: Atha kho Mahānāmo Sakko yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Mahānāmo Sakko Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.25:1.3: ‘kittāvatā nu kho bhante upāsako hotī' ti?
an8.25:1.4: Yato kho Mahānāma buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti:
an8.25:1.5: ettāvatā kho Mahānāma upāsako hotī ti. 2.
an8.25:2.1: ‘Kittāvatā pana bhante upāsako sīlavā hotī' ti?
an8.25:2.2: Yato kho Mahānāma upāsako pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti:
an8.25:2.3: ettāvatā kho Mahānāma upāsako sīlavā hotī ti. 3.
an8.25:3.1: ‘Kittāvatā pana bhante upāsako attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāyā' ti?
an8.25:3.2: Yato kho Mahānāmo upāsako attanā saddhāsampanno hoti no paraṃ saddhāsampadāya samādapeti,
an8.25:3.3: attanā sīlasampanno hoti no paraṃ sīlasampadāya samādapeti,
an8.25:3.4: attanā cāgasampanno hoti no paraṃ cāgasampadāya samādapeti,
an8.25:3.5: attanā bhikkhūnaṃ dassanakāmo hoti no paraṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dassane samādapeti,
an8.25:3.6: attanā saddhammaṃ sotukāmo hoti no paraṃ saddhammasavane samādapeti,
an8.25:3.7: attanā sutānaṃ dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti no paraṃ dhammadhāraṇāya samādapeti,
an8.25:3.8: attanā dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī hoti no paraṃ atthūpaparikkhāya samādapeti,
an8.25:3.9: attanā attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti no paraṃ dhammānudhammapaṭipattiyā samādapeti:
an8.25:3.10: ettāvatā kho Mahānāma upāsako attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāyā ti. 4.
an8.25:4.1: ‘Kittāvatā pana bhante upāsako attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya cā' ti?
an8.25:4.2: Yato kho Mahānāma upāsako attanā ca saddhāsampanno hoti parañ ca saddhāsampadāya samādapeti,
an8.25:4.3: attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti parañ ca sīlasampadāya samādapeti,
an8.25:4.4: attanā ca cāgasampanno hoti parañ ca cāgasampadāya samādapeti,
an8.25:4.5: attanā ca bhikkhūnaṃ dassanakāmo hoti parañ ca bhikkhūnaṃ dassane samādapeti,
an8.25:4.6: attanā ca saddhammaṃ sotukāmo hoti parañ ca saddhammasavane samādapeti,
an8.25:4.7: attanā ca sutānaṃ dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti parañ ca dhammadhāraṇāya samādapeti,
an8.25:4.8: attanā ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī hoti parañ ca atthūpaparikkhāya samādapeti,
an8.25:4.9: attanā ca attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti parañ ca dhammānudhammapaṭipattiyā samādapeti:
an8.25:4.10: ettāvatā kho Mahānāma upāsako attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya cā
